title: Jamaican Tagine Roasted Vegetables
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish combining the warmth of Jamaican spices with the richness of roasted vegetables, all in a traditional North African tagine.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine chopped carrots, sweet potatoes, red potatoes, and onions.
In a small bowl, mix together zesty Jamaican seasoning, tagine spice blend, and a pinch of salt.
Toss the spice mixture with the chopped vegetables until evenly coated.
Brush the vegetables with olive oil and transfer to a large baking dish.
Roast the vegetables in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, add diced roasted red peppers to the baking dish.
Return the dish to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 15-20 minutes.
The vegetables should be tender and lightly caramelized.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
